name: Deep Source Holdings Limited
summary: Deep Source Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the processing, distribution, and trading of bulk commodities and related products in the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, and Singapore. The company also provides securities and derivatives financial services, margin financing services, fund management services, futures contract brokerage services, clearing services, financial derivatives consulting services, commodity trading services, inter-dealer broking in over-the-counter markets, facilitate trading, and derivative trading services.
